sculpt_hat_felt.notes: The painter's felt hat (gameplay/errands-props.js makeHat): rolled and waved brim, pinched crown with a top crease, red band with a bow, barred feather. Origin = brim centre, front +Z, brim r 0.31 m. The feather (HatFeather) is a single sheet: drawn double-sided. LOD tris 2188 / 1256 / 592. Vertex colour only (COLOR_0 linear rgb, written once).
